text.content:
Passages fork here into the Spit-Slicked heart of the Pens, worn smooth by traffic that wasn't always living.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: Somewhere in the Larders, the Wool-Crowned King and his stolen throne of saddlebags is handing out promotions based entirely on who the llamas nuzzle first.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 14 to detect and counter).
